assumptions: Primer-BLAST's mismatch rule for pairing hits into products.
The EMBL-EBI database searched is a collection, not an assembled genome.
limits: Needs the network; cannot be filtered by organism.
bio.jane/contract.question: Do these primer pairs make products off their template, and which pair ranks best by it?

description: Check primer pairs for products off their template, the way NCBI Primer-BLAST does, and rank them by it: each distinct primer is searched against a sequence database at EMBL-EBI with short-query BLAST, hits are paired into products by Primer-BLAST's own mismatch rule, and the template is searched too so the record identical to it is recognized as the intended target. Pairs with no product elsewhere rank first, in the order given, then pairs not checked, then pairs with a named unintended product. Primer sequences and the template LEAVE THE MACHINE; the database is a collection, not an assembled genome, and cannot be filtered by organism.

_files.description: The project: record references shaped like _subject. Their records become library documents a tool names in sequences/parts/document; a trace or alignment is found by file name.

_subject.description: The record to act on: exactly one of sequence, accession (+source), sample (an id from list_samples) or file ({name, text} or {name, base64}); record_index picks one record of several.

database.description: the nucleotide database id, as the service names it (em_all, em_rel_hum…). Left empty, the service's OWN nucleotide default is used and reported back.

email.description: EBI requires a contact address on every submission (their abuse contact, not a login). Left empty, the one saved in any EMBL-EBI panel is used.

pairs.description: several pairs to rank, one per line as `forward reverse` (whitespace or a comma between), in their design order. Taken instead of forward/reverse when given.

template.description: the sequence the pairs were designed on. Searched too: the database record identical to it is where the intended product lives. Left empty, the open record is used; with neither, every product counts as unintended and the result says so.

top_n.description: how many of the pairs, from the top, to search. The rest rank as unchecked. At most 14, so the batch stays inside EMBL-EBI's 30 searches.

name: check_primer_specificity

forward.description: the top-ranked pair's forward primer (wire into pcr_amplify)

identical.description: database records identical to the template, whose products are the intended ones

ranked.description: every pair in ranked order: its design rank, standing (specific, unchecked, non-specific), intended products and unintended products with subject, span, length and mismatches

specificCount.description: pairs with no product off the template; wire into a $when to branch on "any specific pair"
